hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PortForwardSpec.description: PortForwardSpec is what the public port leads to.

protocol.description: The transport the port forwards; it cannot change once the PortForward is made.

target.description: The interface the port leads to. A target that does not exist yet is waited for.

targetPort.description: The port the target listens on, 1 to 65535. The public port is status.port.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PortForwardStatu.description: PortForwardStatus is where the port is open.

ipv4.description: The shared IPv4 address of the target's node, such as "198.51.100.3", where the port is open; empty until the target is on a node that has one.

machine.description: The Machine whose interface the port leads to; empty while the target has none.

node.description: The Node that opens the port: that of the target's machine, kept when the machine goes; empty while the target has never been placed. A deleted PortForward keeps its port until that node has closed it.

port.description: The public port, drawn from 10000 to 32767 when the PortForward is made and unique among every PortForward of its protocol.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.PortForwardTarge.description: PortForwardTarget is one interface of a VirtualMachine or Container in the PortForward's project.

container.description:
Names a Container.

Set at most one of virtualMachine, container.

interface.description: The interface's name, such as "eth0"; empty is "eth0".

virtualMachine.description:
Names a VirtualMachine.

Set at most one of virtualMachine, container.

description: PortForward opens one TCP or UDP port of the node's shared IPv4 address to one interface and port of a VirtualMachine or Container. The public port is drawn at random from 10000 to 32767 when the PortForward is made, and kept until it is deleted; moving it to another target changes only where the port leads. The client's own address reaches the machine, so the interface's SecurityGroups decide what passes, as for its public IPv6. Machines on the same host do not reach a forward at the shared address. See docs/decisions/networking.md.
title: PortForward
